    # Parse the HTML content using BeautifulSoup
    from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')

    # Find all script tags in the HTML
    script_tags = soup.find_all('script')

    # Initialize an empty list to store the code snippets
    code_snippets = []

    # Iterate over each script tag
    for tag in script_tags:
        # Get the text content of the script tag
        code = tag.get_text()

        # Use regular expressions to extract code snippets from the text
        import re
        snippets = re.findall(r'//.*|/\*.*?\*/', code, re.DOTALL)

        # Add the code snippets to the list
        code_snippets.extend(snippets)

    # Return the list of code snippets
    return code_snippets
